summary: Stratasys Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on October 5, 2026, publishing notice of its 2026 Annual General Meeting to be held November 10, 2026, in Givatayim, Israel. Shareholders of record on October 9, 2026 may vote. The agenda covers re-election of seven incumbent directors, initial election of new nominee David Chinn (McKinsey senior partner with defense expertise), and reappointment of Kesselman & Kesselman (PwC Israel) as auditors. The board recommends approval of each proposal. This is a routine AGM notice, not a special situation.
